Templates
=========

This folder contains copy-paste scaffolds used during Staging.

- `arc/`        ARC briefs and ARC-000 foundation templates
- `backlog/`    EPIC/STORY/TASK templates
- `gates/`      SM gate checklist template
- `reports/`    Sprint report templates (Sphinx-ready)
- `sphinx/`     Full `docs/` Sphinx + Diátaxis scaffold
- `staffing/`   Role brief templates (MP output)
- `state/`      state.rst template
- `continuation/` continuation packet template
- `ceremony/`    BO-facing ceremony templates (planning brief, demo feedback, retro brief)
